bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for intersection improvements on marked Trunk Highway 23 in the city of Rockville.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. STEARNS COUNTY STATE-AID HIGHWAY 47; APPROPRIATION.

$1,620,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for the construction of acceleration lanes, right turn lanes, and right turn buffers in each direction of marked Trunk Highway 23 at the intersection of Stearns County State-Aid Highway 47, including preliminary and final design, construction engineering services, and all construction and associated project costs. This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 2. STEARNS COUNTY ROAD 140 AND STEARNS COUNTY STATE-AID HIGHWAY 82; APPROPRIATION.

$1,620,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for the construction of acceleration lanes, right turn lanes, and right turn buffers in each direction of marked Trunk Highway 23 at the intersection of Stearns County Road 140 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 82, including preliminary and final design, construction engineering services, and all construction and associated project costs. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $1,620,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for the construction of acceleration lanes, right turn lanes, and right turn buffers in each direction of marked Trunk Highway 23 at the intersection of Stearns County State-Aid Highway 47, including preliminary and final design, construction engineering services, and all construction and associated project costs. This is a onetime appropriation.

This is a onetime appropriation.
